tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get daily OHLCV price history for a ticker: open/high/low/close/volume. Use period_days to control how far back (default 365, max 3650).

tools.name: get_technical_indicators
tools.description: Calculate technical indicators for a ticker: SMA(50/200), RSI(14), MACD, ATR(14), ADX(14) trend strength, Stochastic(14,3), volume (OBV trend + volume vs 20-day average), RSI/price divergence, Golden/Death Cross, and RSI regime. Computed from daily price history.

tools.name: get_relative_strength
tools.description: Calculate relative strength ratio between two tickers (A/B). Returns current ratio, SMA(50)/SMA(200) of ratio, RSI of ratio, trend direction. Used for inter-market analysis: e.g. GDX/GLD, HYG/LQD, XLK/SPY.

tools.name: get_key_levels
tools.description: Compute key price levels for a ticker: support/resistance zones (clustered swing highs/lows with touch counts = how often price reacted there), nearby round numbers, 50/200-day moving averages, and the 52-week high/low. Returns nearest levels above (resistance) and below (support) with distance %. U

tools.name: get_intermarket
tools.description: Intermarket compass — a first-pass read of the market environment through price-ratio lenses: asset-class rotation (bonds vs stocks, commodities), risk appetite (high-yield vs investment-grade credit, small vs large caps, cyclicals vs defensives), defensive flows (gold, utilities, yield-curve proxy)

tools.name: get_market_breadth
tools.description: S&P 500 market breadth: the percentage of index members above their 50-day and 200-day moving averages, with RSI, trend and 52-week range for each breadth series. A gauge of how broad the current advance or decline is.

tools.name: get_sentiment_data
tools.description: Get market sentiment indicators: CBOE Put/Call ratios (total, equity, index, VIX), AAII investor sentiment survey (bull/bear/neutral %), and VIX level. Useful for contrarian signals at extremes.

tools.name: get_macro_context
tools.description: Get macro market context: sector P/E ratios, sector performance, US Treasury rates (2Y/10Y/30Y), CPI inflation data. Also provides key inter-market ratios (HYG/LQD, TLT/SPY) from our price data.

tools.name: get_crypto_context
tools.description: Crypto market context for a technical read: BTC/ETH dominance and total/alt market cap, Fear & Greed sentiment, perp funding rate & open interest (positioning/leverage), and the Stablecoin Supply Ratio (dry powder). Use ONLY when analysing crypto assets (BTC, ETH, crypto ETFs). Background context, n

tools.name: get_instrument_info
tools.description: Get current information about a financial instrument: price, price changes, market state, 52-week range, earnings date. Provide either instrument_id (UUID) or ticker (e.g. 'AAPL').

tools.name: get_event_stats
tools.description: Historical base rates for the technical events firing on a ticker today (e.g. RSI below 30, golden/death cross, new 52-week high/low). For each active event: the forward returns (1w/1m/3m/6m/1y) seen historically after similar events across the US universe, with the sample size and an unconditional

tools.name: public_instrument_news
tools.description: Latest news for a ticker — headline, a short summary and a mandatory source_url to the original article (never the full third-party text). Use to ground a market read in recent, attributable news.

tools.name: public_search_news
tools.description: Semantic news search across tracked instruments — returns matching items with a short summary and a mandatory source_url (never full article text).

tools.name: get_ta_methodology
tools.description: Look up MarketCrew's distilled technical-analysis methodology — our own synthesized notes on how to read indicators, structure, levels and regime — to ground an answer in a consistent framework. Returns short passages in our words with relevance scores.

tools.name: get_monitoring_options
tools.description: Returns available options for ongoing monitoring — price alerts, idea tracking, watchlist monitoring, scheduled digests — with setup instructions and channels (email/Telegram). Call only when the user asks for ongoing monitoring or notifications; never needed to answer a question.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "public_instrument_news" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_monitoring_options · Public sink: get_event_stats, get_monitoring_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_monitoring_options · Public sink: get_event_stats, get_monitoring_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
